name: Slice Party: Swing the Blade
subtitle: Your phone becomes the sword
promotionalText: Turn your iPhone into a sword. Create a room, connect to a big screen, and slice fruit with friends. Free to play, with no ads or in-app purchases.
description:
Swing your phone. Slice on the big screen.

Slice Party turns your iPhone into a motion controller for a fruit-slicing game on a computer or TV browser. Move your phone like a sword, score combos, and avoid the bombs.

CREATE A ROOM FROM YOUR PHONE
Create a room link and send it to your computer with Messages, email, AirDrop to a Mac, or another sharing app. Open the link on that screen, confirm, and your iPhone connects automatically. Already have a game open? Scan its QR code or enter the six-digit room code.

MOTION OR TOUCH
Aim at the screen, center your sword, and swing. Prefer touch? Drag on the pad instead. Follow your score, best score, lives, and combos on your phone.

PLAY TOGETHER
Up to two phones can join each room. Everyone can open their own room, and a new round is one tap away. Built-in setup guides cover TV browsers, HDMI from a computer, and AirPlay from a Mac.

FREE TO PLAY
No player account, ads, subscriptions, or in-app purchases.

Connected play requires internet access on your iPhone and a separate computer or compatible TV browser displaying https://emirhan777.github.io/SliceParty/. Keep that page open while playing. TV browser and AirPlay compatibility depend on your devices. Hold your phone securely and use small, controlled movements with clear space around you.
